svg.title: Scrunchie strip length and width
svg.desc: An elastic hair tie measures 7 inches around when relaxed. The crochet strip is twice that, 14 inches long, so it gathers to half its length on the elastic. The strip is 2.5 to 3 inches wide and folds lengthwise around the elastic, seamed along the long edge, then the short ends are joined into a ring.
svg.text: The strip is about twice the elastic
Fold along the dashed line around the elastic.
Seam the long edges. Join the short ends.
Rows set the width: at about 5 sc rows per inch,
2.5 to 3 in is 12 to 15 rows, not 8 to 12.
Longer than 2 x the elastic: fuller, bulkier. Shorter: thin gathers.
